chunks.cap: Freelancers get paid late. Buyers paying strangers get scammed.
chunks.say: Freelancers get paid late. Buyers paying strangers get scammed.

chunks.cap: Proofhold binds a payment PayPal already holds to a test both sides agreed to.
chunks.say: Proofhold binds a payment PayPal already holds to a test both sides agreed to.

chunks.cap: The seller writes the brief in plain words.
chunks.say: The seller writes the brief in plain words.

chunks.cap: It becomes an acceptance test: counts, formats, resolution, a deadline, and a judgement line.
chunks.say: It becomes an acceptance test: counts, formats, resolution, a deadline, and one judgement line a machine cannot check.

chunks.cap: One link goes to the buyer.
The buyer reads the same sheet and approves a PayPal authorization, not a payment.
chunks.say: The buyer reads the same sheet, with both signatures and the hash, and approves a PayPal authorization. Not a payment.

chunks.cap: PayPal holds the money. Proofhold never does.
chunks.say: PayPal holds the money. Proofhold never does. The test's hash is written into the PayPal order.

chunks.cap: The seller delivers through Proofhold. Validators measure the files.
chunks.say: The seller delivers through Proofhold. Validators measure the files: how many, what format, what resolution.

chunks.cap: The examiner judges only what a machine cannot, and may abstain.
chunks.say: The examiner judges only what a machine cannot measure, with its reasons shown, and it may abstain. An abstention never releases money.

chunks.cap: The buyer confirms. PayPal captures. The seal is stamped.
chunks.say: The buyer confirms, or stays silent past the window. PayPal captures, and the seal is stamped with the capture id beside it.

chunks.cap: Every hold in one ledger. Objections go to review; a declined offer returns the money.
chunks.say: Every hold lives in one ledger. An objection goes to review; the seller can offer a partial release; a declined offer returns the whole hold to the buyer.

chunks.cap: After capture, PayPal decides. Proofhold files the evidence bundle.
chunks.say: After capture, PayPal decides. Proofhold files the evidence bundle through the Disputes API, with every check and its reasons.

chunks.cap: A printable record is the receipt.
chunks.say: Both sides get a printable record that doubles as the receipt, with the hash-chained history.

chunks.cap: What is real, simulated and unproven is on screen, on every page.
chunks.say: What is real, simulated and unproven is stated on screen, on every page. This recording runs the simulated PayPal client; the sandbox client is in the repository.
